name: BetterRoleDot
description: Copy role colour on RoleDot (accessibility setting) click. Also allows using both RoleDot and coloured names simultaneously

settings.label: Both styles
settings.description: Show both role dot and coloured names

settings.label: Copy role color in profile popout
settings.description: Allow click on role dot in profile popout to copy role color

notes: With Appearance > Role colors set to "Show role colors next to names", the dot after a name in messages and the member list copies the role color ("#rrggbb", with "Copied to clipboard!") when clicked. Both styles keeps names in their role color next to the dot (whatever the setting); the profile option makes the dot before each role in a profile copy its color too, as Both styles also does.
